goal: Time-bound the admin overview's Response Rate and Avg Time metrics to a trailing 30-day window via a FILTER on the responses join, keeping the churn sort + LIMIT/OFFSET pagination in app code and Pending/Reconnect/Last-Activity all-time; relabel the two windowed columns in the admin UI.
non_goals: Do NOT push the churn sort or LIMIT/OFFSET into SQL — the churn formula stays a single-owner JS pure function in src/lib/shared/churn-score.ts (no SQL re-implementation).

Do NOT change src/lib/admin/margin-service.ts — dropped from #482: switching to api_costs_daily_rollups is a no-op at its trailing-30d window (rollups hold only >90d data) and its app-side sort is fine below ~1k accounts (target is 250). Finding recorded on the ticket/map.
Do NOT read or touch api_costs_daily_rollups.
Do NOT change Pending count, Reconnect count, or Last Activity semantics (they stay all-time / current-state).
Do NOT change the churn score computation or the business sort order.
user_visible_behavior: Admin overview 'Response Rate' column now reflects only responses created in the trailing 30 days, and is relabeled 'Response Rate (30d)'.
Admin overview 'Avg Time' column now reflects only responses created in the trailing 30 days, and is relabeled 'Avg Time (30d)'.
Pending, Reconnect, Last Activity, Health badge, and the row sort order are unchanged.
invariants: Business sort order stays: churnScore.score DESC, pendingApprovalCount DESC, name ASC, id ASC — none of which are the windowed columns, so windowing must not change ordering.
overview-service stays born-injected: sql is a parameter; the module never imports @/lib/db/server (db-imports-audit baseline unchanged).
Route handler stays a thin orchestrator (invariant #12); no business logic added there.
Cross-account admin queries stay allowlisted-as-needed in the tenant-scope audit; introduce no new per-tenant scoping and no new flagged pattern.
No new NEXT_PUBLIC_* var; no string-literal subscription/status/tier values (import enums).
The 30-day window has ONE owner (a named server constant); the SQL window, the DTO windowDays field, and the UI label all derive from it — no duplicated magic 30.
edge_cases: Business whose only responses are older than 30d: windowed total=0 -> responseRate=0 (existing total>0 guard); avg time null -> '—'. Pending/Last-Activity still correct from all-time rows.
Business with old still-pending items: Pending count must still include them (all-time status filter, not time-bound).
Dormant business with last activity >30d ago: Last Activity must still show the true (old) timestamp — it is the churn signal.
Business with responses in-window but none approved-in-window: avg time null -> '—'; responseRate computed from windowed total/completed.
existing_patterns_to_follow: src/lib/admin/overview-service.ts metricsRows CTE already uses CURRENT_DATE-based windows (created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - 7 / - 30 / - 35) and COUNT(...) FILTER (WHERE ...) — mirror that exact idiom.
src/lib/admin/cost-report-service.ts returns the window (CostData.days) in its DTO so callers can label it — mirror with OverviewData.responseMetricsWindowDays.
src/lib/shared/churn-score.ts is the single owner of the churn formula — consume it, never duplicate it.
tests_to_add: Windowed Response Rate: responses older than 30d are excluded from total/completed (rate reflects only in-window rows).
Windowed Avg Time: approvals older than 30d excluded; null -> '—' path preserved.
Pending and Reconnect counts remain all-time (an old pending item still counts).
Last Activity remains all-time (a >30d-old activity is still returned).
Sort order is unchanged by windowing (windowed columns are not sort keys).
OverviewData.responseMetricsWindowDays is surfaced and equals the server window constant.
